blurb: The Big Valley Inn was built in 1952. The hotel has been extensively renovated, making it one of the most comfortable places to stay in rural Alberta. The liquor store boasts a wide variety of spirits. The tavern is bright, with a beautiful view of the valley. It is nicely finished in oak and contains 2×6 tables to accommodate comfortable dining. It has 3 VLTs, a pool table and a jukebox.
